verdict.rationale: YYLO Skills is distributed as a Claude plugin marketplace, as a single plugin bundling all canonical skills, and as a GitHub repo that anyone can install non-interactively with `npx skills add`. That gives a lead a shared channel to point the team to, but nothing shows team-oriented rollout. Missing for 10: project-scoped or committed-to-repo installation for a team, team-wide version pinning or enforcement, a custom or private team skill set, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can distribute a standard skill set to my whole team — via a marketplace, a shared repo, or files committed to the project

citations.quote: Install interactively with the open `skills` CLI: npx skills add yylo-dev/yylo-skills
Install all skills for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi without prompts
The repository also exposes one plugin containing all eight canonical skills
Run `yy skills install` or `yy skills update` explicitly to select the latest compatible stable release and update all three agent copies.
